doc.name: Accent site content
doc.instructions: Read-only search and lookup over the published content of www.accentvoice.com. Use site_search to find pages, posts, products and customer stories, then site_get to read one in full. Rate limited per client; on HTTP 429 wait for Retry-After. Use get_budgetary_quote for a non-binding monthly estimate from the published plan prices.

tools.name: site_search
tools.title: Search accentvoice.com
tools.description: Search the published content of www.accentvoice.com (pages, blog posts, products, customer stories). Plain questions work: filler words are ignored, results are ranked by how many terms match (title first), and broad questions return the overview pages. Returns up to `limit` results with collection, slug (absent for pages), route, title and score. Use site_get to read a result in full.

tools.name: site_get
tools.title: Get a page, post, product or story
tools.description: Fetch one published record in full. Pass exactly one of `route` (e.g. "/cloud-phone-system/") or `slug` (looked up as product, then post, then page, then story). Returns a not_found error if nothing is published there.

route.description: Site route with a trailing slash, e.g. /cloud-phone-system/.

tools.name: site_status
tools.title: Content release in use
tools.description: The schema version and release stamp (git, build time, digest) of the content being served. It equals the stamp in /agent/content-index.json.

tools.name: get_budgetary_quote
tools.title: Budgetary monthly price estimate (non-binding)
tools.description: Non-binding monthly estimate for Accent cloud phone and team messaging plans at the published 36-month rates on https://www.accentvoice.com/plans-pricing/ (users × per-user plan price, plus published add-ons). Month-to-month, other terms and annual-billing online-order pricing are not quoted here: request a formal quote. Omit plan to get every plan; monthly.low_from / high_from name the plan behind each end of the range (each plan carries its tagline, e.g. Team is team messaging). Excludes taxes, fees, usage and one-time charges. Each estimate lists the plan's included features as published on the Plans & Pricing page. No personal data needed. For a binding price, send the person to next_steps.formal_quote_url.

users.description: Number of users. Above the service limit the tool answers formal_quote_required.

plan.description: team = Team (Team Messaging); pro = Pro (Cloud Phone, Team Messaging); pro-plus = Pro+ (Phone, Message + Bring Your Own VoIP Phone); premium = Premium (Phone, Message with a VoIP Phone Included)

term.description: 36_month (default) = the published plan-card price. month_to_month is not quoted by this tool: it returns term_not_supported with a formal-quote link.

toll_free_numbers.description: Toll Free Numbers, per number per month

additional_phone_numbers.description: Additional Phone Numbers, per number per month

cloud_e_fax_service.description: Cloud E-Fax Service, per number per month

queue_supervisor_agent_license.description: Queue Supervisor/Agent License, per license per month
